overview: Copper Creek Villas & Cabins are Disney Vacation Club rooms inside the Wilderness Lodge, plus standalone cabins along Bay Lake.
suits: Families and groups who want a newer villa or a private lakeside cabin at the Wilderness Lodge.
rooms:
As a Disney Vacation Club resort, rooms range from studios with a kitchenette to multi-bedroom villas with a full kitchen and washer and dryer. You don't need to be a member to stay; you can book with cash like a regular hotel.

The cabins on Bay Lake sleep up to eight and have a screened porch with a private hot tub.
pools: Guests use the Wilderness Lodge pools, including Copper Creek Springs Pool.
dining: Guests use the Wilderness Lodge restaurants. Story Book Dining at Artist Point is a popular character dinner.
cons: High price, especially for the cabins
Buses to every park except Magic Kingdom
Boat can pause in bad weather
tips: If you book a cabin, budget extra time to walk or ride to the main lodge.
Watch the Electrical Water Pageant from the shoreline in the evening.
bestFor: Families and groups who want a villa or cabin at the Wilderness Lodge.
